title: Voiding Redemptions Recorded in Error on KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
A redemption recorded in error on a KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan — a duplicate repair order, the wrong VIN, or a visit not performed — is voided and the visit restored when the error is reported within the void window days after the redemption. Each redemption is voided at most once. A void is recorded only on a plan whose status is active or fulfilled; voiding the redemption that fulfilled a plan does not reopen it.

## Elements of the rule

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Errors covered | A duplicate repair order; the wrong VIN; a visit not performed |
| Time limit | The error is reported within the plan level's void window, counted in calendar days after the date of the redemption |
| Effect | The redemption is voided and the visit is restored to the plan |
| Repetition | A redemption that has already been voided is not voided again |
| Plan status | Active or fulfilled; no void is recorded on a plan with any other status |
| Fulfilled plan | Voiding the redemption that fulfilled the plan restores the visit but does not reopen the plan; its status stays fulfilled |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

The dates below are example inputs, with a void window of 14 calendar days.

- A redemption dated 2026-02-02 recorded against the wrong VIN, reported on 2026-02-16, the 14th calendar day after the redemption: within the window; the redemption is voided and the visit restored.
- The same error reported on 2026-02-17, the 15th day: outside the window.
- A redemption that already shows a void on the plan's visit history: not voided a second time.

## Points of judgement

**Which errors does this rule cover?** The three named: a duplicate repair order, the wrong VIN, and a visit not performed.

**From which date is the window counted?** From the date of the redemption as it appears in the plan's visit history.

**What happens to a plan whose last visit was redeemed in error?** If the plan is fulfilled and the error is reported in time, the redemption is voided and the visit restored, and the plan's status remains fulfilled.

**Is a void recorded on an expired or cancelled plan?** No. A void is recorded only on a plan whose status is active or fulfilled.
